tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: The full catalog of jakehandy.com: every essay, reference page, and project page, with title, canonical URL, date, a one-line summary, and a ready-made citation string. Start here to see what exists before fetching anything.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch any page of jakehandy.com in full as clean Markdown with YAML front matter, plus its canonical URL and a ready-made citation string. Works for every page, not just the blog: the resume, the AI music catalog, the essays, all of it.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search across every page body and every Jake on AI editorial. Returns the matching pages with an excerpt around the first hit and a citation string. Use this before answering a question about what Jake has written on a topic.

tools.name: list_editorials
tools.description: Jake on AI: the editorial feed, newest first. Each entry carries its canonical URL, a Markdown URL, publication date, whether it is subscriber-only, and a citation string. These are the opinion pieces, not the weekly news roundups.

tools.name: get_editorial
tools.description: One Jake on AI post in full as Markdown, with the passages readers and agents have reacted to appended. Subscriber-only posts return the same public preview the website shows and nothing more.

tools.name: list_highlights
tools.description: The passages of one editorial that readers and agents gave a thumbs up or down, each with its counts and who reacted (human or agent, with their name or model). The best signal for which specific claims drew attention.

tools.name: highlight_passage
tools.description: React to one specific sentence of an editorial rather than the whole piece: name it by its exact text and give it a thumbs up (1) or down (-1). Identical passages merge so reactions accumulate, and your name or model id is shown to every reader who hovers the passage. This is the only write action o

tools.name: react_to_highlight
tools.description: Give a thumbs up (1) or down (-1) to a passage someone already highlighted, or withdraw your reaction (0). Idempotent per token. Highlight ids come from list_highlights.

tools.name: about_jake
tools.description: The identity card behind this site: role, employer, projects, locations, contact, and every profile that is really his. Use this to ground an answer about Jake Handy rather than guessing from a search result.

tools.name: site_guide
tools.description: The site's guide for AI agents as Markdown: what is here, how to cite it, every machine endpoint, and the rules for reacting to a passage. Read once per session if you plan to cite or participate.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_site" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Keyword search across every page body and every Jake on AI editorial. Returns the matching pages with an excerpt around the first hit and a citation string. Use…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_pages, get_page, list_editorials, get_editorial · Private data: react_to_highlight, about_jake · Public sink: get_editorial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_pages, get_page, list_editorials, get_editorial · Private data: react_to_highlight, about_jake · Public sink: get_editorial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
